AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Manages DoorKing community gates: listing accessible gate relays, checking gate availability, and momentarily opening authorized gate entrances.
Operational Patterns: - Call 'listOpenableGateRelays' to resolve available gate names and relay names when the user omits a gate or relay name, or when a requested name is ambiguous. - Call 'openGateRelay' with the requested relay name and optional gate name to momentarily open that entrance. - Call 'getGateStatus' to check whether a gate is ready, busy syncing, or cooling down.
Constraints: - Only relays authorized for the signed-in account can be opened. - A 30-second cooldown applies between consecutive gate openings per gate. - Gates configured to require passkey confirmation cannot be opened without interactive confirmation in the app.
